snippet.title: 6guY2 Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Yes DEEW canonically uses CapCut. what of it

----------------------------
"Make your excitement go fly-by! We are  6guY2!!!" 


After the mysterious departure of a former member, the rookie idol group 6guY2 has one more chance to make things right...  There's drama, betrayal, love and most of all MULTICULTURALISM! oh joy! 

 ★ ★ ★ ★ ★ ★
6guY2 is a free visual novel by n3wh011andFROG. Releases for Windows, Mac and Linux on November 27, 2026 on Itch.
